{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for the presence of commas in revenue
print("Number of revenue entries with commas:", data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Count of refunded orders:", (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check for completed orders
print("Count of completed orders:", (data['status'] == 'completed').sum())"}
